scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @picklescout/shared build && bun run --filter '@picklescout/*' typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run --filter @picklescout/shared build && bun run --filter '@picklescout/*' lint
scripts.test: bun run --filter @picklescout/shared build && bun run --filter '@picklescout/*' test
scripts.build: bun run --filter @picklescout/shared build && bun run --filter @picklescout/backend --filter @picklescout/frontend build
scripts.dev:backend: bun run --filter @picklescout/shared build && bun run --filter @picklescout/backend dev
scripts.dev:frontend: bun run --filter @picklescout/shared build && bun run --filter @picklescout/frontend dev
